text.tspan: index_data job, always for one corpus variant
(bootstrap only on an empty database, otherwise on demand)
Idempotent per (source, variant): upsert data_source by name,
delete its old chunks of THIS variant only
Partial hnsw index for this variant,
built after the insert, never a catch-all

div.p: Corpus quality rule learned the hard way: RAG is exactly as good as the corpus is clean. Re-running any source is safe by design.
Variants let two chunkings live side by side, so re-indexing is a comparison rather than a border. Every reader of the corpus has to name the variant it reads; the topic axis included.
